Pose - Back to Viewer.description:
🕴️ Pose: Back to Viewer
Turned away from the camera, showing the back — mysterious, departing, or looking toward something distant.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Back to Viewer.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, turn the torso partly away so the back and side of the selected Outfit are visible. Rotate the head only enough to preserve selected facial features, eye design, and expression when the frame is expected to show them. Do not change camera angle or crop. Female: the turned shoulder line tips and the spine curves. Male: the back holds square from shoulder to hip. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own back structure.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
